arabic text: Ya rab. Har ek ko ye, s'adat nasibe ho. Karbobala ki sab ko, ziyarat nasibe ho.\nChalo karbala chale. Ay Sheh ke azadaar. Chalo karbala chale.\nAy Sheh ke azadaar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: O Lord, grant everyone this honour; grant everyone the visitation of Karbala\nLet us go to Karbala, O mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Ye dil he bekaraar Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: This heart is restless Let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Abbase name dar-e ke roze pe jayenge Jakar waha sakina ka nawha\nsunayenge Dekhenge wo dayar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: We will visit the shrine of Abbas, the renowned one There we will recite Sakina's lament\nWe will behold that land Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Tar apne asuwo se karenge wo ham zamin Khakar sinaa giraa tha jaha\nakbare hazeen Sab honge ashke bar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: With our tears we will soak that earth where the grieving Akbar\nfell from the spear All will shed tears Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Ehle haram ke khayme jalaye gaye jaha Matam karenge aag ke sholo\npe ham wahaa Jaane kare nisaar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: Where the tents of the Prophet's family were burned upon those flames\nwe will perform matam there We will sacrifice our lives Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Ashke ghame hussain-e milaye furate me Nawho ke sab arize bahaye\nfurate me Mojo ko de Karaar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: We will mix our tears of grief for Hussain with the Euphrates and cast\nour written laments into the river Giving peace to its waves Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Phir pahba rehna jayenge bazaare shame me Zainab gayi thi jis tarha\ndarbare aam me Dil ki he ye pukar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: Then, bareheaded, we will go to the marketplace of Shaam as Zainab went\ninto the public court This is the cry of the heart Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Dasht-e bala me banue dilgir ki fugaa ab bhi sunayi deti hai asghar ki\nhichkiya Aaho ke hai hisaar Chalo karbala chale\nAy Sheh ke azadar. Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: In the desert of affliction, the lament of grieving Bano and Asghar's sobs\ncan still be heard Surrounded by sighs Let us go to Karbala\nO mourners of the King, let us go to Karbala

arabic text: Mehshar bari hai bat-e ke ho shahir-e-hussain Phir to kahenge log\ntumhe zaire hussain Bar jayenga wiqaar Chalo karbala chale
english translation text: It is a great honour at the Resurrection to be known as one of Hussain's city Then people\nwill call you a visitor of Hussain Your dignity will increase Let us go to Karbala
